name: Sabre Jacket Men's
description: Freeride is unpredictable—you can find yourself pits-deep in pow just as easily as you can brush up against rocks, trees, and foul weather. Refined over several generations, the Sabre is our most downhill-oriented, weatherproof technical shell, built for the rigours of going hard inbounds and out. Made with an updated modern fit and multi-panelled aesthetic, it’s packed with pockets and has a helmet-compatible StormHood™, plus a powder skirt. What's been updated: The Sabre’s face fabric has been upped from 80d to 100d for more toughness and durability. We’ve also added a chest pocket for quick access to small stowables as well as an integrated goggle wipe, and we’ve refined the cut for a true modern fit.

name: Sabre Pant Men's
description: Inside the ropes or out, the Sabre Pant is built burly enough to handle brushes with rocks and trees, designed to be technical enough to seal out errant pow, and cut low enough to let you breathe. Made from waterproof, breathable GORE-TEX ePE, its contemporary silhouette balances backcountry function with resort-friendly form. With a roomier fit in the thighs and a supple, durable instep patch to prevent bunching, there’s even more freedom of movement. What's been updated: The Sabre Pant’s face fabric has been upped from 80d to 100d for more toughness and durability. The new instep patch is made with Hadron® yarns to improve durability and weight, while also being flexible to prevent bunching. We’ve also updated the pant to a true regular fit.
